_comment: The association's calendar, and the only file edited to change it. ONE row per event,
both languages side by side. Every field has a hard length range enforced by
i18n/events.py, so `python3 i18n/build.py` fails rather than rendering a card taller
series    decides the emblem in the card's footer -- see SERIES_EMBLEM in events.py.
role      organiza | colabora | asiste. What MULTITEC did here, and the one thing this
audience  publico | socios. A members' event has no sign-up link and never will.
start     YYYY | YYYY-MM | YYYY-MM-DD | YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM. Which form you use IS the
statement of how well the date is known. 00:00 means the time is unrecorded.
tentative true = our best information, not a promise. Prints `aprox.` and replaces the
image_kind photo (cropped) | poster (letterboxed) | logo (contained, for a mark or a
drawn illustration when no picture of this edition exists).
